scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build && npm run copy-frontend-dist
scripts.vercel-debug-build: node -v && npm -v && npm run build --workspace @property-management/shared && npm run build --workspace @property-management/frontend && npm run copy-frontend-dist
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace shared
